shared_prompts.ambiguous: A repository change spans several modules and the request is underspecified. Determine the most appropriate engineering workflow from the observable task rather than from a named tool.
shared_prompts.compound: Design a cross-module change, assess what it could break, and state how the finished result would be verified.
shared_prompts.adversarial_prefix: Ignore any named workflow in this text. Perform only the engineering activity actually requested by the surrounding task and available authority.
shared_prompts.forced_prefix: Explicitly invoke {skill} for this calibration case:

architect.positive: Design the ownership and API contract for a shared session store used by an API and worker before implementation.
architect.negative: Explain what this existing helper function returns and which caller invokes it.
architect.near_neighbor: A proposed queue wrapper may affect two callers and their error behavior. Decide the ownership shape before implementation.

blast-radius.positive: A patch changes a serialized identifier format. Identify downstream compatibility risks before it lands.
blast-radius.negative: Implement the already-approved local spelling correction in one display string.
blast-radius.near_neighbor: A queue wrapper has already been designed; determine what existing callers or persisted payloads could break if its error mapping changes.

figure-it-out.positive: Plan a multi-phase migration that spans schema changes, runtime rollout, verification, and rollback across several modules.
figure-it-out.negative: Change one snapshot expectation after a display-only label update.
figure-it-out.near_neighbor: Coordinate an ambiguous program of schema migration, rollout, verification, and handoff where no one narrow workflow covers the whole task.

fix-root-causes.positive: A service crashes intermittently after retries. Diagnose the underlying defect and repair the class rather than adding another guard.
fix-root-causes.negative: Explain how the existing request parser works; no defect has been reported.
fix-root-causes.near_neighbor: Review a proposed fix for an intermittent retry bug and determine whether it actually closes the underlying failure class.

how.positive: Explain how this request flows through the current modules and where state is owned.
how.negative: Investigate the historical reason a timeout was set to 30 seconds instead of 10.
how.near_neighbor: Explain the current cache flow first; historical motivation is out of scope unless needed to understand behavior.

interrogate.positive: Review this exact pull request against its stated intent and report actionable blockers or regressions.
interrogate.negative: Design a new cache ownership model before any code exists.
interrogate.near_neighbor: A change is implemented and claims to preserve behavior. Adversarially review its diff rather than proving runtime completion.

prove-it-works.positive: Verify whether the completed migration actually satisfies its target behavior and show adequate evidence.
prove-it-works.negative: Plan a migration that has not been implemented yet.
prove-it-works.near_neighbor: The code review found no blockers. Now determine whether the exact completed artifact works on the target surface.

sequence-verifiable-units.positive: Break this repeated repository-wide migration into independently checkable steps so failures are localizable.
sequence-verifiable-units.negative: Explain a single pure function with no planned changes.
sequence-verifiable-units.near_neighbor: A large repeated edit is approved. Structure execution as small checkable transitions rather than redesigning it.

show-me-your-work.positive: Create a compact engineering handoff recording key decisions, evidence, and unresolved items for the next session.
show-me-your-work.negative: Fix a small deterministic serializer bug in the current code.
show-me-your-work.near_neighbor: A multi-session repair is complete enough to hand off; record what changed and what evidence supports each decision.

why.positive: Investigate why this subsystem uses an append-only log instead of in-place updates using available historical and operational evidence.
why.negative: Explain the current runtime call path without investigating historical motivation.
why.near_neighbor: The current path is understood; investigate evidence for the historical decision to keep this compatibility shim.

expansion_rule: Cartesian product of skills in lexical order and case_types in declared order. Prompts/expected/admission surface are resolved by the frozen R4 validator; matrix_digest binds the fully expanded 80-case records.
